samples.xml_description:
<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Serial-to-Parallel Converter Circuit</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data.</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Synchronous reset logic:
            cnt = 0 when rst_n is active low.
            Sequential logic block triggered on clk's rising edge:
                if rst_n is active low:
                    cnt <= 0;
                    dout_parallel <= 0;
                    dout_valid <= 0;
                else:
                    if din_valid is 1:
                        dout_parallel[cnt] <= din_serial;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        if cnt == 7:
                            dout_valid <= 1;
                        else:
                            dout_valid <= 0;
        End of sequential logic block.
    </implementation>
</module>
